clips.title: The story
paras: At Ashenvale's northwestern edge, Zoram Strand faces the Veiled Sea. The shore holds the ruins of an ancient night elven city, now overrun by Wrathtail naga, shipwrecks, and beached leviathans. Blackfathom Deeps begins in the submerged temple complex nearby.

Ten thousand years ago, the night elven city of Zoram stood on this coast. The Great Sundering tore Kalimdor apart and sank the settlement beneath the sea. Now the tide brings ancient relics, shattered vessels, and the carcasses of massive sea beasts onto the shore. Wrathtail naga overrun the beaches and tidal pools, guarding the flooded ruins and ancient artifacts from anyone who comes near.

Travelers from the mainland and along the coast still come to Zoram Strand despite the naga. South of the shore, the Horde holds Zoram'gar Outpost, where its warriors fight to secure the coast. Nearby, Blackfathom Deeps lies deep within the caverns. The ancient temple of Elune has fallen into dark hands, drawing scouts, scholars, and treasure seekers who brave the surf.
